facts.fact: The State House says President Tinubu launched the NINAuth App, a mobile identity authentication application developed by NIMC, on 30 October 2025, with about 1.3 million verification hits a day.
The State House says NINAuth is a digital, mobile-based identity authentication app launched on 30 October 2025, for citizens and residents to prove identity to businesses and services.
